description: Réseau d'assainissement collectif - CA Vichy Communauté - 2018 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by vichy-communaute.fr. Implementation of the collective sewerage network of the agglomeration. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Collective sewerage network - CA Vichy Community - 2018" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include eaux pluviales, réseau, assainissement, eaux usées, unitaire, CA Vichy Communauté. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
